summary: Iteration 26 regression pass after refactors (Home split, Admin hooks, Nav/Footer sub-components, booking validation util, logError util, emailer _layout spec) plus the 3 new failure-path behaviours. Backend pytest suite (65 tests across inbox/arabic-alerts/email-confirmations/security-audit) all pass. Static checks pass (0 eslint problems, no console.* outside logger, no hardcoded admin password in tests). Frontend home renders all data-testids; media category preselect works; admin login/tabs/titles OK; booking failure path shows booking-submit-error with '800 364', keeps form data, no confirmation; AR partner and AR chauffeur failure paths show Arabic error with '800 364' and hide success, and success returns after unroute.

integration_issues.issue: After unrouting the 500 mock and resubmitting with only name/phone/email filled, the real POST /api/contact returns 422 (backend requires 'message'). The Arabic form allowed submission without 'message' (client-side does not enforce it). Only affects the resubmission scenario; failure banner + Arabic message + hidden success all verified correctly.

action_items: (Optional) Add required-'message' client validation for /ar/chauffeur-service to match backend Contact schema, or make message optional server-side.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactors are behaviour-preserving as advertised: home sections, admin hooks/banners, nav/footer sub-components, booking validation util. logError util replaces console.error consistently (grep verified). Emailer _layout spec unified for contact/booking previews.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@egmg.ae / EgmgAdmin2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and backend/.env ADMIN_PASSWORD)
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed contacts/bookings cleaned from Mongo (contact_submissions, bookings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests read REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. tests/conftest.py loads backend/.env but the URL comes from frontend/.env, so run pytest with: export $(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env) before pytest. Booking POST schema requires 'duration' in {'4h','8h'} and 'date' field (different from BookingSubmission model). Wizard testids: duration-4h/8h, date-picker-trigger, time-picker-trigger, pickup-location-input, dropoff-location-input, passengers-3/4/6, vehicle-card-*, input-name/email/phone, btn-submit-booking, booking-submit-error. AR partner form uses input placeholders (Arabic) not data-testids; error banner appears as [data-testid='ar-partner-submit-error'] / 'ar-chauffeur-submit-error' after failed submission.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical regressions. Minor: AR chauffeur form lacks client-side required validation for 'message' textarea so an all-optional-look submission yields 422 from backend Contact schema (message is required server-side).
